attchmntText: TTK Prestige Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: TTK Prestige Limited has intimated the schedule for an analyst conference under SEBI LODR Regulations. The company will participate in an investor conference conducted by Avendus Spark on November 17, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. in Mumbai. During this event, the company will share un-audited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company will also present a gist of information relating to these results. This information was previously shared with stock exchanges on November 06, 2026. The intimation is submitted for the information and records of the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited.

attchmntText: TTK Prestige Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript
voiceSummary: TTK Prestige Limited has uploaded the transcript of its earnings call held on 06.11.2026 to its website. The company previously intimated the earnings call via a letter dated October 15, 2026. The transcript is available at the link https://ttkprestige.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Transcript_Nov062026_Final.pdf. This filing is in compliance with SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015. The announcement was signed by Manjula K V, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: TTK Prestige Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: TTK Prestige Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper advertisement of its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement appeared in Business Line, Economic Times, and Dinamalar on November 07, 2026. The company enclosed a copy of the advertisement for the exchange's records. The provided text also contains unrelated news reports on Hindalco Industries, GSPL Transmission, Gujarat Pipavav Port, and Gujarat Energy, which are not part of this specific corporate filing.
